units: valid_from <= now_gsc < valid_until; unsigned u64 500 MHz GSC ticks, no wrap interval
crc: CRC32C reflected Castagnoli poly0x82f63b78 initial/final xor0xffffffff. payload_crc32c covers 16 payload bytes; record_crc32c covers all96 bytes with its own4 bytes zero.
payload_source: calibration_dsp_implementation.json calibration_table.fields; 128bits signed gainQ16/DCinteger and reserved-zero bits
acceptance: Structural validity, payload/record CRC, exact expected immutable IDs/generation/channel/direction/reference and half-open time interval required. These checks do not validate hardware binding. production_binding_valid and matching nonzero binding_id separately authorize calibration_valid. Missing binding preserves decoded logical payload with UNBOUND result and calibration_valid false.
lifecycle: Caller must validate inactive immutable storage, pin generation and atomically commit at safe boundary; API does not write MMIO, GPIO, RF enable or mutate an active table.
